question: After the schema defect is fixed, should this plugin-artifact slice be restacked onto the RFC's grouped `claws add` and one-new-agent lifecycle before merge?
rationale: The live RFC explicitly treats the current stack as prototype evidence requiring restack, so implementation tests cannot decide the permanent CLI and workspace-ownership contract.

options.title: Restack on grouped add
options.body: Preserve the useful installer and provenance mechanics but integrate them only through the accepted one-new-agent lifecycle.

options.title: Approve current apply contract
options.body: Explicitly sponsor caller-selected workspace apply and its stored-state compatibility surface as the permanent core design.

options.title: Pause the implementation stack
options.body: Keep Claws in RFC incubation and do not merge this slice until product direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Restack on grouped add
recommendation.body: Preserve the useful installer and provenance mechanics but integrate them only through the accepted one-new-agent lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: He supplied the clearest current maintainer-side product-model decision for the RFC contract that this implementation must follow.
